MoneyV2.description: Decimal currency units, at most 1000000000000.00; never an IEEE-754 number.

NoticeDetailsV2.description: Optional recruitment-notice details shown to candidates. Display text only; never an automatic eligibility rule. noticeUrl is empty or an http(s) URL; opensOn is on or before the closing date.

JobDraftValuesV2.description: Version 2 job payload accepted by the negotiated J3 editor endpoints. Cross-field rules and semantic examples accompany this schema; JSON Schema alone cannot compare sibling amounts or resolve timezone transitions.

JobPublishValuesV2.description: Also requires complete compensation, questions, conditional thumbnail alt and current server availability/source review. Business relationships are checked independently by both implementations.

HiringJobV2.description: Public view only: no editable wizard values, recruiter contact, source-review evidence or confidential pay. The legacy salary string remains a display label with the real period; it is not a numeric annual fallback.

HiringJobPrivateV2.description: Public view only: no editable wizard values, recruiter contact, source-review evidence or confidential pay. The legacy salary string remains a display label with the real period; it is not a numeric annual fallback.

anyOf.description: Exact units, at most 1000000000000.00; no implicit conversion.
